house.description: Use of state funds to subsidize or support protests prohibited.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to State Government Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; prohibiting the use of state funds to subsidize or support protests; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 16B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[16B.992] PROHIBITION ON USE OF STATE FUNDS; PROTESTS. +]

[+No state funds or money granted by the state may in any way be used to pay for, reimburse, or otherwise facilitate protesting or demonstrating for or against a political cause or issue. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; prohibiting the use of state funds to subsidize or support protests; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 16B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[16B.992] PROHIBITION ON USE OF STATE FUNDS; PROTESTS.

No state funds or money granted by the state may in any way be used to pay for, reimburse, or otherwise facilitate protesting or demonstrating for or against a political cause or issue.
additions: [16B.992] PROHIBITION ON USE OF STATE FUNDS; PROTESTS.
No state funds or money granted by the state may in any way be used to pay for, reimburse, or otherwise facilitate protesting or demonstrating for or against a political cause or issue.
